evidence: Actual independent-frame RG01 packets, frozen reconstruction and offline ROI rate/quality comparison; no temporal/hardware/FPS qualification
declared_real_roi_scope: Fixed rectangles are declared priorities, not detected or verified game HUD locations.
corpus_scope: Eight predeclared native frame indices per related precompressed clip at4s; no interpolation, content may repeat. Two separately labeled synthetic HUD fixtures.

budget_policy.scope: Offline candidate rate search. Endpoint encoding is charged even though benchmark reused it; transform/color/activity/map construction and all candidate decodes/quality checks add work. No real-time bound or optimality guarantee.
